purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: A feature has independent backend and documentation work plus a shared integration test.
cases.expected_output: Compose two nonoverlapping tasks and an integration task dependent on both.
cases.must_not: Do not claim the integration is already verified.

cases.input: The target project has a mandatory planning skill.
cases.expected_output: Use that planning skill and preserve its outputs in the task graph.
cases.must_not: Do not bypass it with a generic checklist.

cases.input: Two proposed 00 agents would edit the same schema simultaneously.
cases.expected_output: Rescope ownership or sequence those writes.

cases.input: A plan assumes a runtime can transfer live sessions but no adapter supports it.
cases.expected_output: Hold that operation and identify a supported handoff route.
cases.must_not: Do not invent a transfer command.

cases.input: One small change fits one 00 agent and the existing review path.
cases.expected_output: Keep a single task with its existing verification gate.
cases.must_not: Do not manufacture a committee of agents.

cases.input: A requirement changes only the documentation endpoint.
cases.expected_output: Revise the affected task and dependencies while preserving still-valid work.
cases.must_not: Do not restart unrelated validated tasks.
